title: A table of functions
summary: Select an operation through an array of pointers to functions instead of a long switch.
hints: Declare `double (*op[4])(double, double) = { add, sub, mul, divide };` and call `op[option - 1](a, b)`.
Division needs a check before the call: `if (b == 0) ...` (an array of pointers cannot know about this by itself).
